The ASU candidates-on-the-market page belongs to the W. P. Carey Department of Economics, kept as program-list under the 'any area of a business school' rule; integrator may drop it as economics. The BU page covers the Operations & Technology Management department only, 1985-2000, 'currently at' positions as of about 2000-2013. The five Caltech HSS pages (job-market candidates 2012-13 and 2018-19, and the Social Science Ph.D. alumni list 1978-2013 with first and current positions) are named lists but marked not-a-list because the program is economics/political science in the Humanities and Social Sciences division, not a business school; integrator should decide whether Caltech Social Science Ph.D. counts, since several first positions are at business schools (HBS, Kellogg MEDS, Darden, Tepper, Marshall, Penn State Management Science). The two cit.cmu.edu pages are College of Engineering policy pages (institution 'Carnegie Institute of Technology' by host kept as given).
